description: crl.rs lines 78-82: when crl.tbs_cert_list.next_update is None, the expiry check is skipped entirely. RFC 5280 §5.1.2.5 states nextUpdate is optional for v1 CRLs but RECOMMENDED. A v2 CRL without nextUpdate is unusual. Silently accepting a CRL with no nextUpdate means an arbitrarily old CRL is accepted indefinitely — a stale CRL cannot be detected. This is a security hole: an attacker who obtains an old CRL can suppress revocation detection permanently.
title: CrlChecker skips expiry check when nextUpdate is absent
